findings.finding: The cut07 archive does prove a private test surface: lib.rs:133-134 declares m1_trust_region_stage1 under #[cfg(test)], and the module's BVLS04 controls/helpers are therefore absent from normal production compilation. It does not prove the final package manifest/dependency surface, because Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock are not members of the immutable cut07 archive.
findings.required_disposition: Treat private/noncritical classification as provisional until the final exact-head manifest and dependency diff are reviewed. Any manifest, production consumer, or cfg-boundary drift requires conservative reclassification and applicable gates.

The later receipt pin sets match that restored byte hash, and this JSON is not compiled Rust input; however, start/end pin equality cannot establish uninterrupted support custody during the earlier commands.

findings.required_disposition: Resolve and independently re-review the fixed classification, including a positive-lambda control for the scaled-collapse case, before any source or release decision.
